origin.summary: Workout 3 of the 2011 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 5-minute AMRAP alternating single reps of a squat clean and a jerk at one fixed barbell weight.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2011/3 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; one round = one squat clean + one jerk; the clean must be completed before the jerk is attempted
